program.name: Lower Focus
program.subject: Legs & glutes
program.blurb: Two lower-body days for every upper day, in straight sets.
program.about: Two lower-body days for every upper day, in straight sets. One leg day focuses on squats and the other on single-leg work, and the upper day keeps you balanced. Level II moves you one weight up and Level III brings harder variations. For stronger legs without neglecting the rest.
